events.text: Schembri joined Austria Kärnten on a two-year deal.

events.quote: Schembri joined Austria Kärnten on a two-year deal on 19 June 2009

events.text: Schembri was one of few players who was allowed to be released.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Schembri was one of few players who was allowed to be released in January 2010

events.text: His only goal for the Austrian club came in a 2–3 defeat against Kapfenberger SV.
events.subject: self
events.quote: His only goal for the Austrian club came in a 2–3 defeat against Kapfenberger SV on 26 July
